mandatoryOutputFacts: Retain original JSON objects/business fields and original array ownership. The provider works on persistent semantic state; transfer changes geometry, generated section arrays and conditional container/junction fields in original owner objects.

Importer maps original nodes/ports/edges/sections/labels to their source JSON objects. Section new-generated ID is original edge JSON ID + _s + zero-based current section ordinal; existing JSON section and its id are reused verbatim. A new section is not retroactively entered in original ID map by transfer.

Only nonempty current section list replaces original sections array. Existing per-section bendPoints/incomingShape/outgoingShape/incomingSections/outgoingSections keys are only overwritten when respective actual nonempty/non-null state requires; absence does not invent deletion. Nonempty property junctionPoints writes adjusted points; absent/empty leaves existing key untouched.

Single simple original section auto-populates both incoming/outgoing shapes only if both were absent; one present does not trigger synthesis of the other. Relations resolve after all original sections import and missing references throw.

First complete containment preorder pass transfers only nodes/ports while recording final global offsets and modes; second pass transfers only edges/labels. Properties/runtime child objects are skipped as non-layout values.

Shape mode INHERIT falls back via json parent mode then PARENT; edge mode via json parent mode then CONTAINER. Effective mode for a shape position is read from its JSON parent. Root has no JSON parent and transfers x/y unchanged.

Global position accumulates final relative x/y with original shape ancestor; edge label ancestor is original edge owner, not current edge container. Edge current geometry coordinates are in actual current container.

Edge CONTAINER passes coordinates and writes current containing node identifier; PARENT adds current container global and subtracts original JSON owner global; ROOT adds current container global. Shape ROOT adds applicable parent global. No new rounding/tolerance.

Native JSON serializer/typed collections/semantic inverse adjacency are host adapters, not new GWT/EMF runtime ports. Reuse reviewed E09 number_text only for JS Number-to-string places such as generated ID suffix; actual JSON geometry remains numeric.

GWT $H is object identity hash side effect with whole-process nextHash counter, not a graph-specific numbering algorithm. Raw strict differences remain; no proposal to fake equal counter values or silently redefine old comparison profiles.
intendedFirstImplementation: Persistent provider session and mandatory original-JSON transfer for fixed/box/random; full behavior above is source-defined rather than a flat-only claim. Additional recursive algorithm scheduling/hierarchy/cross-provider validation and error mapping remain separate.
notApproved: Copying full GWT JSON/hash/collection or EMF runtime from support observations
Full 243 option parsing or upstream malformed-input permissiveness
